name: commitlore
description: Decision memory from Git history, with verified capture for coding sessions.

interface.shortDescription: Preserve verified engineering decisions in Git
interface.longDescription: CommitLore gives Codex decision context from Git history and a verified capture route for constraints, ruled-out alternatives, and warnings that a diff cannot retain.
defaultPrompt: Read the decision context for the files I am about to change
Capture the decision behind this commit with verified evidence
Check whether this implementation approach was already ruled out
